conversion: Lossless WebP; no resizing, cropping or artwork edits
campaign_scope: Map renders registered story encounters; no fighters or save IDs are created by the map.
lossless_pixel_verification: Decoded source and runtime RGBA pixels compare equal
road_overlay: One independent trace per stage; no straight water-crossing connector between regions
visual_marker_review: All 123 marker centers visually reviewed against approved art in six regional static overlays; browser interaction/label review is separate.
